name: Right to Privacy and Data Protection
Human Rights and Civil Liberties
summary: Use or misuse of a technology system in a manner that compromises fundamental human rights and freedoms.

name: Autonomy
summary: Loss of or restrictions to the ability or rights of an individual group or entity to make decisions and control their identity and/or output.

name: Cross-cutting (method-level)
summary: This question is about a research method or evaluation property that applies regardless of which harm is being investigated -- not mapped to a specific harm type.
